title: Illuminating ligand-induced dynamics in nuclear receptors through MD simulations.
authors: Yu, Tracy; Sudhakar, Nishanti; Okafor, C Denise
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Gene regulatory mechanisms
one_liner_zh: 该综述聚焦核受体的配体诱导构象动态的MD模拟方法，虽涉及转录因子家族但核心是蛋白-配体互作而非蛋白-DNA结合，与TF-DNA互作课题关联较弱。
abstract: Nuclear receptors (NRs) regulate gene expression in critical physiological processes, with their functionality finely tuned by ligand-induced conformational changes. While NRs may sometimes undergo significant conformational motions in response to ligand-binding, these effects are more commonly subtle and challenging to study by traditional structural or biophysical methods. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are a powerful tool to bridge the gap between static protein-ligand structures and dynamical changes that govern NR function. Here, we summarize a handful of recent studies that apply MD simulations to study NRs. We present diverse methodologies for analyzing simulation data with a detailed examination of the information each method can yield. By delving into the strengths, limitations and unique contributions of these tools, this review provides guidance for extracting meaningful data from MD simulations to advance the goal of understanding the intricate mechanisms by which ligands orchestrate a range of functional outcomes in NRs.
abstract_zh: 核受体（NRs）在关键生理过程中调控基因表达，其功能通过配体诱导的构象变化被精细调节。尽管核受体有时可能因配体结合而发生显著的构象运动，但这些效应通常更为微妙，难以通过传统结构或生物物理方法研究。分子动力学（MD）模拟是弥合静态蛋白质-配体结构与调控核受体功能的动态变化之间差距的有力工具。在此，我们总结了近期应用MD模拟研究核受体的若干研究。我们展示了分析模拟数据的多种方法，并详细考察了每种方法所能提供的信息。通过深入探讨这些工具的优势、局限性及独特贡献，本综述为从MD模拟中提取有意义的数据提供指导，以推进理解配体如何协调核受体中一系列功能结果这一复杂机制的目标。
